content: Expo SDK 57 is current as of Aug 2026 (expo@57.0.11, released June 30 2026): React Native 0.86, React 19.2. Expo Go store builds ship SDK 57 (expo.dev/go shows SDK 57 latest). SDK 54 (Sep 2025) receives critical fixes until next SDK (Sep/Oct 2026). Expo Go not recommended for production apps per Expo, but valid for this personal Expo Go workflow.
